author: World of Warcraft
description:
Introducing Roofus, an industrious builder and lovable new companion pet ready to accompany you on all your adventures in World of Warcraft in both Modern and Classic Progression (currently Mists of Pandaria Classic) realms. This pack comes with Housing decor items for your home in Modern WoW, including a customizable dog house, bed, and bowl! Perfect for relaxing after a ruff day. 

By purchasing The Roofus Pack, you’ll be supporting Habitat for Humanity, an organization that has helped provide housing and shelter for more than 65 million people across the globe!

Learn more at: https://shop.battle.net/product/world-of-warcraft-the-roofus-pack

Now through May 12, 2026, 10am PT, Blizzard Entertainment will donate 100% of the purchase price of “The Roofus Pack” digital bundle to Habitat for Humanity less any chargebacks, refunds, transaction fees, and Value Added Taxes (VAT), or other similar taxes paid.
